scenario: LSER.6.11.3 — a series read takes no window argument: the window is the declaration's, chosen by the cursor's label. `mean(t.reading, 10_s)` passes a second argument to `mean`, whose only argument is its cursor, so it is DS_VALIDATE_BAD_ARITY. The declared line is `mean sliding 10_s`, so the refusal does not depend on whether the window would have matched: the argument itself is outside the language. Drives the Mercury compiler's series-aggregation call resolution; a compiler that accepts the extra argument as a window fails this.
rules_ds:
schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    reading: Float mutable

series Sensor.reading:
    mean sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where mean(t.reading, 10_s) > 2.0
->
    log info "x"
